queenstown-south-island-central-otago-vi.story: Leave the city behind and spend the day on roads with texture. Out of Cromwell and back again: 511 km, roughly 9 h 27 in the saddle. It goes by way of Queenstown / South Island, Central Otago Vineyard, near Te Anau and Queenstown. near Kingston is the high point. It tops out at about 1,300 m.
